# Better Measure

> Better Measure is a 100% black female-owned, family-run event and creative solutions company based in Alberton, Gauteng, South Africa, with 20+ years of combined experience. We deliver end-to-end events across South Africa.

## What we do
Full-service event planning & management, express (last-minute) event solutions, brand activations & experiential campaigns, project & logistics coordination, RSVP & accreditation management, creative direction & content, catering, marquee & structure hire, branded apparel, and promotional items.

## Who we're for
South African brands, corporates, and institutions — from intimate brand launches to large-scale international convenings and high-profile/government functions.
